description: Turn on Slack for a project: install the gardenio Slack app, give the bridge its tokens, and bind a channel to the project. The installs and the binding are gated human steps; checking the result is a task.

vars.name: project
vars.description: Project to bind the channel to (the type:project bead name)

vars.name: channel_id
vars.description: Slack channel ID (channel details, About; starts with C, or G for an old private channel). Not the #name

vars.name: role
vars.description: Role an @mention in the channel spawns, and whose agent cards route back to it

steps.title: Install the gardenio Slack app in the workspace
steps.description:
Human step for a Slack workspace admin.

Create the app from gardenio/slack/manifest.json, the single source of truth for its scopes, slash commands, events and Socket Mode: api.slack.com, Your Apps, Create New App, From a manifest. For an existing app, paste the manifest under App Manifest and save. Install (or reinstall) it to the workspace; Slack only grants changed scopes on reinstall. gardenio/slack/README.md explains the bot and user scope blocks.

Close this step once the app is installed.

steps.title: Give the Slack bridge its bot and app tokens
steps.description:
Human or operator step. The slack-bridge needs the bot token (`xoxb-`, as SLACK_BOT_TOKEN) and an app-level token with `connections:write` (`xapp-`, as SLACK_APP_TOKEN, for Socket Mode). Store both as secrets in the deployment (the Helm chart reads them from secretKeyRefs); never paste a token into a bead, a comment or Slack.

If you are not the operator, file `gb escalation create --requesting-task <this step's id>` naming the two secrets, and close this step when it is done.

steps.title: Create or pick the Slack channel and invite the gardenio app
steps.short_title: invite the app to the channel
steps.description: Human step in Slack. Create the channel (or pick an existing one), then invite the app with `/invite @<app name>` in it. Check that its ID matches the one this formula was poured with (`{{channel_id}}`).

steps.title: Find the {{project}} project bead
steps.description:
```sh
kd list --type project
```

Comment the id of the bead titled {{project}} on the bind-channel step.

steps.title: Bind channel {{channel_id}} to {{project}} with {{role}} as its handler
steps.short_title: bind the channel to the project

steps.title: Verify the bridge sees channel {{channel_id}} and routes it to {{project}}
steps.description:
The project-to-channel cache has a TTL of about 30 seconds, so allow a moment.

```sh
gb slack channels                         # the bot is a member of {{channel_id}}
kd show <project-bead-id> --json \
  --jq '.fields | {slack_channel, channel_roles}'   # {{channel_id}} listed, mapped to {{role}}
```

Tell the person what to look for in Slack: the next agent card for a {{role}} agent on {{project}} lands in this channel.
